compact_value.recipe: M is largest absolute repeat-level prediction error of training-selected fits; S is largest same-fold/same-identity prediction difference to another accepted numerical start. Routine uses future cohort only; stress takes maxima across future and seven separate folds. Widths are fixed before the new-paper outcomes, not estimated confidence levels.
limitations: Reused architecture-selection data
Overlapping and nonexchangeable folds
Tiny source/band blocks
Two numerical continuations do not define a parameter distribution
A new high-J band can exceed all historical errors
No correction to any point prediction
